purpose: BronchoTools is a three-module extension for image-guided bronchoscopy. It provides Video Input (streams a webcam, video file or image sequence into a volume), Bronchoscopic Depth Map Generation (estimates depth maps and point clouds from bronchoscope frames with a published 3cGAN model) and Endoluminal Phantom Builder (builds a wall and a casting mold from a lumen segmentation for 3D printing).
summary: I read the CMake files, VideoInput.py, the depth-map library files and Models.json in full. I grepped the depth-map module and the phantom builder for install, download, network, subprocess, eval/exec, deletion and sys.path behaviour. I found no malicious or concealed behaviour and no telemetry. Package installs are limited to opencv-python-headless and cv2_enumerate_cameras, installed only after a confirmation dialog. PyTorch is never pip-installed; the module only tells the user to install it through the PyTorch extension. The model weights download needs confirmation and is SHA256-pinned. The catalog entry pins `scm_revision` to the branch `main`, and `EXTENSION_DEPENDS` is "NA" although the depth module needs PyTorchUtils at run time. Both are minor, non-blocking points. I did not read the full 1666-line depth-map module or the 2026-line phantom builder. Recommend merge.
